verdict.rationale: Close publishes an llms.txt at developer.close.com, confirmed live by a probe (HTTP 200). It includes an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section telling agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown. Many doc pages are served as .md, and an OpenAPI spec is published and probe-confirmed. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs, and the full contents of the llms.txt index are not shown (the root `/.md` probe returned a Not Found page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.close.com/llms.txt # Close | Developer API Documentation

## Instructions for AI Agents
For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
